prints.title: Glue-on SMA antenna bracket
prints.summary: A small L-bracket glued to an enclosure that holds a rubber-duck antenna upright on its SMA bulkhead connector. Three per plate.
prints.material: PLA (PETG if the box lives outdoors in the sun)

prints.title: Corgi figure, 10 cm
prints.summary: A sculpted corgi from Nomad Sculpt, scaled to 10 cm nose to tail and printed standing on its feet.

prints.title: Insta360 GO Ultra latch mount on a cold shoe
prints.summary: A printed version of the official Quick Release Mount's principle: two hooks click into the latch slots under the GO Ultra's Action Pod, release buttons at both ends, GoPro prongs underneath, on a cold-shoe foot with a lock wheel. Nothing touches the screen, buttons, ports or lens.
prints.material: PLA (base, prongs, mount hardware: TNT, 0.12 mm, 6 walls, 60 % gyroid) + TPU 95A (sponge pad: Gås)

prints.title: Ram skull headpiece and skeleton pieces
prints.summary: A ram skull with sweeping horns that sits on the head, a 21-piece spine, 8 arm pieces and 6 ribs, in white PLA over four plates.

prints.title: Wall mount for iPad 11-inch (portrait)
prints.summary: A screw-on cradle the iPad stands in, with the middle left open for a USB-C charging cable, plus two turn clips that hold the top edge.

prints.title: iPhone 11 case with honeycomb and name inlay
prints.summary: Snap-on case with a fading honeycomb and a stencil-cut name. A colored inner plate fills the cutouts and frames the camera.
prints.material: PLA prototype (TPU for the final case)

prints.title: Hand-held rig for two depth cameras
prints.summary: A two-handed rig with a passive two-axis gimbal on 608 bearings for two stacked Azure Kinect DK depth cameras, one fanned up and one down, for recording and streaming RGB and depth on the move.
prints.material: PLA-CF (black structure) and PLA (orange moving parts, knobs, phone mount)

prints.title: Hand-held depth-camera rig, printed-fastener version
prints.summary: The two-Kinect gimbal rig rebuilt from what is on the shelf: every bolt, nut, axle, dowel and thumbscrew is printed; only the 608 bearings and brass heat-set inserts are bought-in parts already owned.
prints.material: PLA-CF (black frame), orange PLA (gimbal, knobs), grey PLA (printed hardware), TPU (straps, feet)

prints.title: Wide-baseline rig for two depth cameras
prints.summary: Two Azure Kinect DK depth cameras on their sides at the ends of a 1 m aluminium tube, toed in on one person for a fuller point cloud, worn on backpack straps with a chest rest and two grips.
prints.material: PLA-CF (black structure) and PLA (orange pad, clips, phone mount, knobs); 25x25x1.5 aluminium tube

prints.title: LED controller enclosure
prints.summary: A screw-together PETG case for an 8-output LED controller board: rounded base with 16 collared panel-connector holes on a recessed front panel, an Ethernet slot, antenna and power holes, diamond vents and gusseted mounting ears, and a lid with a honeycomb vent field.

prints.title: Projector air filter lid (v0 estimate)
prints.summary: A printable replacement for a missing air-filter lid on an ultra-short-throw projector. It takes a cut sheet of G3/G4 ventilation filter mat instead of the original filter: slot vents over the media, and a clamp ring that presses the sheet's edge onto the filter seat. A test ring checks the fit first. Shape study: dimensions are estimated from a photo and must be measured before printing.

prints.title: Sun mask with glued-on rays
prints.summary: A sun face mask, 19 cm across, with 16 rays (8 wavy, 8 straight) printed separately and glued around it: 37 cm in all.
